metadata.dataset_observation: FRS 2024-25 spine; capital gains amounts drawn from HMRC Table 3 (size of gain by taxable income, 2024-25) with asset types from HMRC Tables 7 and 8, gains qualifying for Business Asset Disposal Relief and Investors' Relief imputed from HMRC Table 4, and the sub-exempt remainder drawn from the Advani-Summers within-band distribution; household weights calibrated to 1,215 targets, among them HMRC's CGT totals, size bands, gains by taxable income band (Table 3), age, region, the BADR bands (Table 4) and residential property gains
metadata.dataset_notes: The build's projection fence bounds the gainers that uprating carries over the frozen exempt amount by 2030 at 7.0k, against HMRC's 73k taxpayers with gains of £3,000 to £5,999 in 2024-25 (Table 2.1a); this repo's uprating audit counts 7.1k on policyengine-uk 2.132.6.
metadata.dataset_columns: It carries capital_gains, capital_gains_residential_property (the residential schedule) and capital_gains_badr (gains qualifying for Business Asset Disposal Relief or Investors' Relief), and no carried-interest column.

centax_2019_20.source: CenTax, Reforming Capital Gains Tax: revenue and distributional effects (Advani, Lonsdale and Summers)
centax_2019_20.scope: Equalisation with income tax rates (20/40/45, gains stacked on income), one rate for all assets: BADR, Investors' Relief and the separate residential and carried-interest rates abolished; principal private residence relief kept
centax_2019_20.note: 2019-20 rules and data: main rates 10/20, residential and carried interest 18/28, BADR 10%, exempt amount £12,000; resident individuals; CGT and income tax counted together

centax_package_context.source: PolicyEngine derivation from CenTax, Reforming Capital Gains Tax: revenue and distributional effects (Advani, Lonsdale and Summers)
centax_package_context.scope: Equalisation with income tax rates (20/40/45, gains stacked on income), one rate for all assets: BADR, Investors' Relief and the separate residential and carried-interest rates abolished; principal private residence relief kept
centax_package_context.note: Not a CenTax figure. CenTax adds the uplift at death (gains on assets held until death are not taxed; £1.3bn) and exit-charge (£4.3bn) components without a behavioural response; subtracting them from the no-allowance package (£13.8bn, Table 4) leaves about £8.2bn for rates alone.

centax_package_context.source: CenTax, Reforming Capital Gains Tax: revenue and distributional effects (Advani, Lonsdale and Summers)
centax_package_context.scope: Package: equalisation plus a rate-of-return investment allowance, removal of the death uplift, and rebasing on arrival with a deemed disposal on departure
centax_package_context.price_basis: nominal, scaled to the OBR's 2025-26 CGT forecast
centax_package_context.note: The headline £14bn: a medium-term effect on the 2025-26 base.

centax_package_context.source: CenTax, Reforming Capital Gains Tax: revenue and distributional effects (Advani, Lonsdale and Summers)
centax_package_context.scope: Package: equalisation plus a rate-of-return investment allowance, removal of the death uplift, and rebasing on arrival with a deemed disposal on departure
centax_package_context.price_basis: nominal, scaled to the OBR's 2025-26 CGT forecast
centax_package_context.note: The package's yield across CenTax's elasticity range.

centax_package_context.source: CenTax, Technical note: equalising tax rates across different types of income
centax_package_context.scope: Package: equalisation plus a rate-of-return investment allowance, removal of the death uplift, and rebasing on arrival with a deemed disposal on departure; baseline after the October 2024 rate rises
centax_package_context.note: The package on the post-Autumn-Budget-2024 baseline.

centax_package_context.source: CenTax, Taxes at the top: understanding what high earners pay (Advani, Hughson and Summers)
centax_package_context.scope: Package: equalisation plus a rate-of-return investment allowance, removal of the death uplift, and rebasing on arrival with a deemed disposal on departure; baseline after the October 2024 rate rises
centax_package_context.price_basis: nominal, scaled to the OBR's March 2026 CGT baseline
centax_package_context.note: Increase in revenue 62%, down from 88% in the 2024 report; no elasticity value stated.

centax_package_model.measure: Change in CGT revenue, £bn, on this repo's own liabilities in the year, nominal: the headline reform (equal rates, the relief kept) after the behavioural response at the elasticity shown. CenTax's figures are the change in CGT revenue from their whole package, which also withdraws the relief, a percentage applied to the OBR's CGT forecast.

ready_reckoner.source: HMRC, Direct effects of illustrative tax changes (ready reckoner), June 2025
ready_reckoner.locator: Capital gains tax rows; notes 13 and 14
ready_reckoner.measure: Exchequer receipts in £m (positive = yield), including income tax and stamp duty land tax (SDLT) effects, for a change to the named rate, on the OBR's March 2025 forecast
ready_reckoner.note: The higher-rate rows move the higher and additional rates together, for main and residential gains (note 13); rows are non-linear and must not be scaled (note 14). The BADR rows raise the relief's rate from its 18% in 2026-27. HMRC deferred the 2026 edition on 6 July 2026 pending a review of key assumptions, so these rows are provisional.

excluded.reason: A lower rate above the higher rate breaks the explorer's ordering rule.
The explorer changes rates and the relief, not the exempt amount.

ready_reckoner.model_measure: Change in government balance, £m, on this repo's liabilities in the model year, with each row's rates and relief (the main and residential rates move together; the BADR rows move the relief's rate), the official case applying 3.6 to main-rate gains and 1.4 to gains qualifying for the relief
